title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Financial Management → GeneralLedger
architecture_notes: Workday Financials uses worktags rather than chartfields. Every financial transaction is coded with a combination of worktags: Ledger Account, Fund, Cost Center, Revenue Category, Spend Category, Grant, Program, Gift, etc. Worktags are hierarchical and institution-configurable. Data extraction via: RaaS (custom financial reports), Workday Web Services or REST API (Financial Management), or outbound EIBs. Workday Data Cloud zero-copy is an optional, separately priced add-on; Prism brings data into Workday rather than out.

source_objects.description: Journal header: journal number, ledger, date, status, accounting date, created by. Equivalent to PS_JRNL_HEADER.
Journal line detail: ledger account, worktags (fund, cost center, spend category, etc.), debit/credit amount, memo. Equivalent to PS_JRNL_LN.
Chart of accounts: account number, name, type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense). Equivalent to PS_GL_ACCOUNT_TBL.
Period-end balances by worktag combination. Equivalent to PS_LEDGER.
System-generated accounting entries from sub-ledger transactions (AP, AR, Payroll). Source journals.

extraction_methods.description: Build custom financial reports (Journal Lines, Trial Balance, Budget vs Actuals) in Workday Report Writer. Expose as REST endpoints for scheduled extraction.
Brings outside data into Workday for reporting there. Not an extraction path for a lakehouse.
Use /journalEntries, /ledgerAccounts, /balances endpoints. Supports paging and filtering.

Zero-copy access to Workday financial data over Apache Iceberg, separately priced. Financial data was targeted for general availability in 27R1. Not required for HELIX; RaaS and Web Services are the default.
